title: Introduce subnet-set failover allocator, cross-account egress roles, and DNS priming orchestrator
author: Asha Menon
description:
Motivation: Private control planes in multi-AZ customer environments require deterministic failover when subnets are degraded, cross-account egress role provisioning for outbound NAT/privatelink use, and an idempotent DNS priming step to ensure resolvers observe freshly created control-plane endpoints. This PR introduces three coordinated pieces: 1) a 'subnet-set' allocator that groups AZ subnets into primary/failover sets with deterministic selection and graceful draining hooks; 2) cross-account egress IAM role templates and an installer flow to provision and rotate those roles when customers request egress via a partner account; 3) a DNS priming orchestrator that performs staged Route53/forwarding priming and health probes to reduce DNS convergence time during control-plane switchover. The changes touch Terraform modules, Helm values for the installer operator, and the control-plane state reconciliation code.

What this PR does (summary): - Adds terraform/modules/subnetset allocator module with idempotent plan/apply behavior and tagging scheme for ownership and lifecycle. - Adds terraform/modules/egress-role to create cross-account IAM roles and managed policy attachments with a minimal trust boundary and rotation hook. - Adds installer helm chart values and a small controller (cmd/controlplane-reconciler) that orchestrates subnet-set failover and invokes DNS priming using a new controller job. - Introduces a DNS priming job image and k8s Job template with exponential backoff probe logic to avoid thundering herds. - Adds unit and integration tests for the allocator and end-to-end smoke test in the perf-canary harness.

Checklist: - [x] Terraform module + documentation - [x] Helm chart values + migration notes - [x] Controller + e2e smoke test - [x] Security review for cross-account role trust policy - [x] Linear tickets linked (ENG-2231, ENG-2278)

Operational notes: The subnet-set allocator uses a deterministic hash of VPC ID + AZ + cluster-id to pick primary/failover sets and writes subnet tags used by the control plane reconciler to pick the correct subnets. The egress role module emits outputs consumed by the installer to populate ExternalAccountPrincipal fields. DNS priming is opt-in via helm value installer.dnsPriming.enabled (default false) to avoid surprise behavior for existing customers. The PR includes migration documentation under docs/installer/migrations/subnetset-2025-11.md.

review_comments: Diego Morales (reviewer): The allocator looks good overall; please add an explicit backoff/limit to the drain hook to avoid long-lived maintenance windows.
Asha Menon (author): Added a maxDrainDuration parameter with a default of 15m and wired it through the helm values and Terraform tag TTL. PTAL.
Priya Kapoor (reviewer): Need clearer note on the risk surface for the cross-account role; can we scope the trust policy to a specific sts:AssumeRole ARN rather than wildcard?
Asha Menon (author): Updated iam_policy.json to include a required external_id check and an allow-list for caller ARNs; also added rotation guidance in the docs.
Liam O'Neill (SRE): CI failed initially due to flaky dns-priming test (timing). Re-ran the job and it passed. Recommend adding a jitter to probes; not required for merge but flagged for follow-up.
Asha Menon (author): Added probe jitter and increased probe timeout in the helm job template; noted TODO to surface histogram metrics for probe durations.
release_notes:
- Introduce subnet-set allocator for deterministic AZ failover and graceful draining.
- Add cross-account egress role terraform module with rotation guidance.
- Add optional DNS priming orchestrator (helm value installer.dnsPriming.enabled).
- Migration guide: docs/installer/migrations/subnetset-2025-11.md.
